mechanism: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) antagonizes dopamine agonist effects by serving as a cofactor for aromatic amino acid decarboxylase, potentially reducing pramipexole's therapeutic efficacy in Parkinson's disease.
action: Avoid concurrent use of high-dose vitamin B6 supplementation (>25 mg/day); monitor for reduced pramipexole efficacy if B6 supplementation is necessary, and separate dosing times if unavoidable.
